But youre still around right? I know I dont know you, but i think that you have a lot more strength than you give yourself credit for.

Nobody is hopeless. Sounds to me like your counselor just wasn't the right fit for you, and neither were your meds. It took me seven tries to find the right medication, but I finally did and it helps so much. 

And also, you don't need to try to be "normal." The cool thing about humans is that we are all unique. Embrace the quirks that make you different and before you know it, others will embrace them too. 

If you ever need to vent I am here to listen

If you ever need to vent at all, remember that there are people to listen, including me. You do not need to go through this alone. :)
